FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Sweet Tooth Confectionery, we operate as a retail candy and confectionery store dedicated to providing a delightful shopping experience for all sweet lovers. Our core operations include sourcing a wide variety of candies, chocolates, and other confections from licensed and inspected manufacturers, ensuring high-quality products for our customers. We maintain strict adherence to local health department regulations and food safety standards, with all staff holding the necessary food handling certifications.

Our storefront is designed to attract customers with vibrant displays and a warm atmosphere, offering a selection of both traditional and artisanal confections. We prioritize customer service and have implemented robust inventory management systems to minimize shrinkage and ensure product availability. Sampling and tasting stations are utilized during special promotions, with comprehensive hygiene protocols to ensure a safe and enjoyable experience for our guests.

Additionally, we are committed to creating an allergen-aware environment, clearly labeling all products for customer safety. Sweet Tooth Confectionery focuses on retail operations, which further reduces risks associated with fire and liability. Our operations are conducted during standard business hours, with a focus on providing a secure and inviting space for families and individuals alike.
